note: Atchison County KS: no queryable zoning polygons found. The City of Atchison publishes its Zoning District Map only as a Google Drive file (not a REST service). The county's 2021 Neighborhood Revitalization Plan says zoning applies only where the county overlaps the City of Atchison; Zoning Atlas lists the county as having no county-level zoning. A ArcGIS Online 'Zoning_Districts' service (f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) has 1,129 polygons but none within the county bounding box, so it is not used.
